notes.title: Major Update #2: Control Overhaul
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/4e7f45c0676e55b5b7dee912dce73d4dba6a9464.png"]


Howdy, Gunslingers!

We’ve just dropped a brand new update that gives you total control over how you play Dino Path Trail. Whether you’re a hardcore keyboard tactician or a twin-stick gamepad predator - this one's for you ːsteamhappyː
🎮 TOTAL CONTROL! (LITERALLY)
Full Key Rebinding - Every key. Every action. Map them however you want, no compromises.

Twin-Stick Setup - Move with one stick, aim with the other. Smooth and deadly.

Steam Input Support - Plug in and play. Seamless support for your controller setup of choice. 

This is something many of you have been asking for, and we’re excited to finally deliver it. Suit up, customize your controls, and blaze your own trail.

We’d really appreciate your feedback on this update - especially the new control features. 

Let us know how it feels, what works, and what could be better. Your input is super valuable - come chat with us in our Discord!



And stay tuned - our next update is coming soon ːccheartː



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/c7abcd5c285535a1d9236e7759ef8f392b638576.png"]

notes.title: Update #3: Fixes, Balance & Tweaks
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/625f5df4e7be40864070769dff39a9546e4f8d65.png"]


Howdy, Gunslingers! 

We’re back with our third regular update since launch - another step toward making your run through Dino Path Trail smoother, tougher, and more balanced.

A big thanks to all the users that are reporting bugs and giving us feedback! Especially, thanks to Trampoflix for all the bug reporting! ːccheartː



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that was preventing Trails Unlocks from spawning in some maps that had 2 connections

Fixed an issue that allowed players to access the weapon wheel while their map was open, resulting in unintended behaviors

Fixed an issue that would cause the tutorial to get stuck under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue that would cause Ptero-who-sees to completely disappear when changing phases

Fixed an issue that was causing some effects of the challenge mode to be added multiple times when changing maps

Fixed an issue that was causing weapons to disappear after being crafted from scratch or upgraded

Fixed an issue that was causing Players to go into negative numbers when losing money

Fixed an issue that was causing dino coins to not be removed from the player when upgrading the basecamp and then closing the game

Balance

Improved Dino Ghost spawn timings to be more clear and allow a bigger window for the player to dodge out of the way

Challenge mode lightning strikes now won't be able to target the player while in enclosed spaces (Caves, Farms, etc)

Challenge mode lightning strikes will now be foreshadowed by Ptero-who-sees laughter

Defeating Ptero-who-sees now completely stops the lightning strikes from happening

Additions

Added Achievements for beating challenge modes (Stage 3, 6 and 9)

Additionally, we're getting ready for the next Major update which is going to be releasing very soon. Stay tuned!



P.S. You can see all planned major updates on our Steam Page and Discord

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/471b8e8f577242759869a15896edbab398a516af.png"]

notes.title: Major Update - New Meta Progression And More
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/482438dcd0cc12366034cae1ee4a961256df76ee.png"]
Howdy, Gunslingers!
The number one thing you asked for is finally in the game. And it’s a big deal. Like, T-Rex-sized.

Meta progression has stomped into Dino Path Trail and it’s changing everything. From now on, every run helps you grow. Win or lose, you’ll walk away stronger, with permanent rewards that unlock tools, upgrades, shortcuts, and cool stuff back at the Hub.

Frustrated by starting from scratch after every defeat? Not anymore. This system makes bouncing back way smoother. You’ll kick off new runs with better gear, more options, and a real sense of progress.

With tons of long-term goals to chase, this update adds a big dose of strategy and replayability. Ready to see what’s new?


🛠️ Hub Upgrades and Permanent Unlocks
Tool System Overhaul
Tools can now be permanently unlocked in the Hub. Start runs with your favorite gear and jump right into the action. Stone shovel? Child’s play. Let’s get serious.

Base Camp Construction
Use Dino Coins to unlock and upgrade your crafting tables. Skip the slow stuff and go straight for the spicy builds.
🏕️ Hub Growth Systems
Buff Gate Upgrades
More choices, more rerolls, and more ways to start strong. The Buff Gate just got buffed.

Scavenger Stands
She's back, she’s loud, and now she’s selling your old loot. Expand her market and grab powerful gear from past runs at a discount.
💀 Bounty Hunter System
Difficulty, Your Way
Take on tougher challenges with escalating difficulty levels and juicy rewards. Finish a run to unlock the next tier and keep climbing.

Custom Modifiers
Every level adds new twists. Hungry faster? Ghost dinos? Random lightning? Oh yes. It’s chaos and it’s glorious.

High Risk, High Reward
Crank up the pain and earn extra Dino Coins while you're at it. Get serious or go extinct.
🗺️ Quality of Life and Balance Changes
Source Icons added to the minimap so you can find what you need without wandering like a lost raptor.

Increased FoV on the minimap for better visibility and planning.

Maps are now slightly smaller to cut down on running and ramp up the action.

Day cycle is longer, so there’s more time to explore before the sun goes down.

Fewer enemies spawn in each map, making things feel less like a mob rush and more like a survival challenge.

Difficulty now ramps up faster, keeping the pressure high and rewarding efficient players.
📈 Why This Changes Everything
You asked for it. We wanted it. And now it’s here.
Meta progression makes every run matter. Even if it ends in disaster, you still get stronger, smarter, and more prepared for the next.

Your tools evolve. Your Hub expands. Your strategy deepens. And your chances of survival? Well... let’s just say they won't improve.



Jump back in and start carving out your legacy.
What will you unlock first? What challenge level will you dare to face?



🦴 See you back on the trail!

notes.title: Update #2: Fixes & Tweaks

 Panacea now correctly removes all Debuffs

 The following mods will now work on all shots:
- Explosive Bullets
- Hunter Bullets
- Penetrating Bullets
- Ricocheting Bullets
- Thunder Bullets

notes.title: Update #1: Fixes, Tweaks, and More
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/9a2644d12046539f100129c74fc35584fd268f90.png

Howdy, Gunslingers!

Huge thanks to everyone who's been playing, dying, surviving, and sharing feedback on the full release of Dino Path Trail. We read everything, and every report helps us make the game better. Your feedback’s been a huge help - please feel free to share more on Discord or right here on Steam. We’re checking everything ːccheartː

Today we’re rolling out our first patch - a solid batch of bug fixes, tweaks, and polish to make your survival smoother, nastier (for the dinos), and just a little more fair (for you… most of the time) 🦖

🛠️ Here’s what’s changed in this update:


 The following achievements are now properly unlockable: First Steps, Poison for Everybody, Lucky Cowgirl, Fire and Flames, Blood Everywhere, Bulletproof vest!, The Old Team.
 Removed a bug that allowed you to craft higher-tier items without having built the required worktable level.
 Removed a bug that would cause players to spawn in the first exploration map without weapons/throwables.
 The game is now warning you when it is saving. You will also be warned when quitting the game. 
(We are also working on a possible way to allow you to manually save in the exploration maps and regenerate them in one of the future updates)
 Added an option to easily switch display from the Graphics Settings.
 Fixed a bug that was allowing you to die in the tutorial using explosives.
 Fixed a bug that was affecting your max health negatively when leaving the tutorial map and starting your first run.
 Bounty Hunter and Scavenger are now properly triggering their services when you build their homes in the hub. 
(They will also give you an introductory dialogue where they explain what they do)
 Fixed a visual bug related to the Bug Report tool not closing properly.
 Fixed a bug that was allowing you to craft and possess more than 1 mod of the same type, which was consuming your materials and sending the crafted mod into oblivion. 
(This bug was probably also related to weapons upgrades doing the same, but we are still tracking this bug)
 Fixed the items acquired notification getting stuck on the left of the screen in some situations.
 Interacting too soon with the chest to pick the mod in the tutorial is no longer possible and will prevent you from getting stuck there.
 Fixed a bug that was spawning only the scavenger in NPC tiles.
 Fixed the second part of the tutorial to properly trigger combat music.
 Fixed a bug that was not visually updating the bounty after moving to a new map.
 Lowered prices of shops inside and outside run.
 Decreased “Slow” status effect on the drawing and shooting speed of weapons.
 Fixed a bug that caused the smelter to smelt the wrong amount of items.
 Fixed a bug that caused items to be consumed twice when using a two handed weapon.
 Increased the delay between money floating texts.
 Fixed a bug that was preventing the loading screen to disappear at the end of the loading process.

Thank you for all your support - we love you all ❤️
See you on the trail!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/0853b7d1c0dae3f8834cc9c21b23be9ba58ceb06.png

notes.title: Dino Path Trail is OUT NOW! 🦖
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/ae6a7b6adde69066c666a1e205dd6b416ed2f9e2.jpg

Howdy, Gunslingers!

We’re beyond excited and we’re so happy to finally say this: 
Dino Path Trail is OUT NOW on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=qCUTwA-Js_U;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as Lucy, a bounty-hunted gunslinger on a mission to rescue her kidnapped sister. Travel across deadly, procedurally-generated biomes, manage your survival, and fight off bandits, raptors, and much worse. Every death is just another step on the trail.

🦖 What awaits you:

 Survival Action Roguelike
Scavenge, craft, and fight your way through randomized biomes where danger increases over time. Manage hunger, thirst, and health - or die trying.
 Mobile Base Camp
Build and move your dino-pulled camp across the frontier. Upgrade your workbenches, expand your shelter, and try to stay one step ahead of the chaos. It’s not a safe haven- but it’s the closest thing to one.
 Combat With Consequences
Outlaws, bounty hunters, and predators roam the land. Gunfights get tougher the longer you survive. Modify weapons and use elemental ammo to adapt - or get overwhelmed.
 Persistent Progression & Story
Each run reveals more about the world, its characters, and Lucy’s strange connection to the Dino Path. You’ll lose gear between runs, but keep unlocked recipes and discoveries.
 Plausible Prehistoric Creatures
The team worked with a real paleontologist to ensure dinosaurs are believable - no giant scaly movie monsters here. Just scientifically grounded, deadly creatures in a world that forgot to evolve.

“What started as a passion project is now a fully-fledged game fueled by sweat, survival, and a stubborn refusal to quit. We spent over 3 years building Dino Path Trail - not just as a game, but as a world. Every zone, enemy, and mechanic was crafted with care. It’s surreal to finally share it.”

The Void Pointer team

🛒 Dino Path Trail is out now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481670/Dino_Path_Trail/

Thank you for your support, chaos, and feedback throughout development 💚

Now it's your turn to hit the trail. 

WE LOVE YOU!

notes.title: 🦖 Dino Path Trail launches May 9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/74250c7b6c9777e7fcfef0dbb294d6804e3e06e6.png

Howdy, Gunslingers!

We’re thrilled to announce that Dino Path Trail, a brutal survival action roguelike where apex predators roam the frontier, is officially launching on Steam this May 9!

🎥 Watch the Official Release Date trailer:[previewyoutube=z0Azxl574dI;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as Lucy, a bounty-hunted gunslinger on a mission to rescue her kidnapped sister. Travel across deadly, procedurally-generated biomes, manage your survival, and fight off bandits, raptors, and much worse. Every death is just another step on the trail.

🔥 What to expect in Dino Path Trail:

 Action Roguelike with survival mechanics: Stay alive across deadly biomes - deserts, swamps, frozen peaks - where death is just the beginning. Loot and craft for survival - a nice additional touch to classic roguelike formula;
 Bounty system: The longer you survive, the more they’ll want your head. Expect tougher enemies and more chaos;
 Mobile base: Upgrade and move your dino-drawn camp - your one safe place in a world that wants you dead;
 Persistent story: Unravel a bigger narrative across multiple runs. Even in death, the world remembers;
 Gunfights with bite: Shoot it out with outlaws, dino-riders, and apex predators using modifiable weapons and elemental ammo;
 Prehistoric but plausible: The team collaborated with a real paleontologist to ensure anatomically accurate dinosaurs, staying up to date with the latest discoveries. While maintaining some creative freedom to keep them fun and engaging, they successfully avoided common pitfalls - like depicting raptors as oversized scaly monsters. Expect creatures that are both thrilling and believable, blending scientific accuracy with imaginative flair.


"Dino Path Trail is the result of three and a half years of relentless passion and dedication. Just a shared dream that refused to die. And neither did the dinosaurs." - Void Pointer Team

🛒 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481670/Dino_Path_Trail/

Thank you all so much! ːccheartː
Your feedback shaped the trail. Your chaos fueled the frontier.
On May 9, it’s your turn to survive it.

notes.title: Dino Path Trail Demo - New Update is Live
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/a5706897ebe1e7fb19d0ca24e2f1d6ae2cb3d33f.jpg

Howdy, Gunslingers!

First and foremost, we’d like to thank everyone who has played and shared their feedback on Dino Path Trail Demo! We truly appreciate it. Your input helps us shape the game, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us on Discord  and Steam! ːccheartː

Today, we're releasing the new update with another round of fixes and improvements to make your dino-hunting, gun-slinging, and survival-roguing experience smoother, faster, and deadlier (for your enemies, not you… hopefully). 🦖

Here’s what’s changed in this update:

🛠️ Major Fixes:

 Reworked Difficulty Scaling: Adjusted difficulty progression to feel more balanced across different runs. Less unfair spikes, more "I should have dodged that!" moments.
 Faster, More Responsive Weapons: Every weapon now feels snappier and quicker to use, making combat more fluid and satisfying.
 Improved Mouse & Keyboard Interaction: You can now interact with close objects without having to "aim" at them. Smooth and simple!
 New Game Shortcut: You can now start a new run directly from the end-game screen. Because who needs a break, right?

🐛 Minor Fixes & Tweaks:

 Swarm Tactics Upgrade: Enemies now attack with more widened timing when ganging up on you. Stay sharp, Gunslinger!
 More Lichens! Increased spawn rate, so go gather them like a true survivalist.
 Weapon Wheel Bug Fixed: If you were struggling to equip weapons properly with mouse & keyboard, that’s now fixed.
 Craft Confirmation Prompt Added: Closing the crafting interface with pending crafts will now ask for confirmation instead of making you regret your life choices.
 Inventory Full Bug Squashed: Items will no longer mysteriously disappear when your inventory is full. No more void-eating your loot!
 Stun Fix: Now all enemies can be properly stunned. Time to test your crowd control skills.
 Chain-Crafting Now Works Properly: Fixed an issue where items weren’t being consumed correctly when crafting multiple times in a row.
 Molotov Nerfed: The burning area duration has been reduced. Less standing in fire, more actual fighting.
 Shotgunner Enemy Damage Lowered: Getting blasted at close range is still painful, just... slightly less deadly now.


🔥 That’s All for Now!
Another patch, another batch of fixes and improvements. Thanks for all your feedback, bug reports, and cowboy-dino chaos! Keep those six-shooters loaded and let us know how these updates feel!

notes.title: Dino Path Trail Demo Live at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/f507b1289d415ac1a799236856bca1241e4434c4.jpg
Howdy, Gunslingers!

After more than 3 years of development, we’re thrilled to announce that Dino Path Trail is live at Steam Next Fest with a brand-new demo!

Y’all have been tearing through the Wild West (with dinosaurs, of course), and thanks to your feedback, we’re dropping another big ol’ patch to make your journey smoother, fairer, and a bit less... buggy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738220/Dino_Path_Trail_Demo/

Follow the game on Twitter and join the Discord server of Dino Path Trail.

Here’s what’s new, what’s fixed, and what’s been wrangled into submission:

🛠️ Major Fixes:

 Perfect Dodge Rework: Now smoother, better, and actually worth mastering!
 Throwables Now Have Manual Aiming! No more “oops, I meant to throw it over there!” moments. Time to git gud with your dynamite tosses.
 Status Immunities Are Now, Well... Immune! Blessings that were supposed to prevent certain status effects will now actually do so.
 A Fairer Expedition Map: Travel map generation has been tweaked to make routes more fair and better for planning. Less RNG frustration, more strategic choices!
 Modded Weapons & Smelting: Smelting a modded weapon will now return the base weapon along with the mods, instead of just eating everything into oblivion.
 Stat Recap Added! You can now see a breakdown of your stat modifiers in your backpack, including Damage, Health, Speed, Defense, Evasion, and Regeneration. Some of them are still wildly inaccurate, but we’re working on that.
 Boss Fight Map Performance Boost: We heavily optimized the boss fight map, making it run way better. (Still working on a few things, though!)
 Difficulty Curve Adjustments: Rebalanced to keep things challenging but fair.
 Less Empty Maps, More Resources: We reduced the vast emptiness of certain areas and rebalanced resource distribution to make exploration feel better.

🐛 Minor Fixes & Tweaks:

 Time Keeps on Slippin’… But Not Anymore! Run duration will now STOP when the game is paused. No more losing precious seconds while taking a snack break!
 Guns 101: The first time you pick up a rifle or shotgun, a set of slides will now pop up to explain how to use it. No more accidental “I thought this was a melee weapon” moments!
 Camp Expansions Actually Cost Money Now! Yeah, turns out Little Thump wasn’t charging for building expansions. He was just being way too generous. That’s been fixed.
 Storage Box Crafting Works Correctly! Crafting with materials inside the storage box will now actually consume them. No more infinite resource magic tricks!
 Weapon Mods Won’t Freeze the Game Anymore! Applying a mod at the shop will now actually work instead of freezing time itself.
 More Egg Shrines! Special zones now spawn at a better rate. Go hatch those dino babies!
 No More Duplicate Revolvers! Fixed a bug in the second tutorial map that was handing out extra revolvers like party favors.
 Auto Equip Weapons & Throwables: Newly picked-up weapons and throwables will now auto-equip whenever possible. No more digging through menus mid-combat!
 Better Diary Sorting: Uncraftable elements now stay at the bottom, where they belong.
 Shooting Through Walls? Not Anymore. You wish you had wall hacks, but we fixed a bug that let you shoot through some obstacles when standing too close.
 Slot Deletion Dialog Fix: Now works as intended. No more menu weirdness.
 Backpack Duplication Exploit Fixed: You can no longer cheat your way into extra inventory slots by picking up the same backpack multiple times. Nice try, though.
 Smelting Improvements: Non-modded weapons now properly return materials, and you can smelt equipped items without unequipping them first. Oh, and warnings will let you know if you're about to melt something important!
 Unlock Messages for New Gear: Weapons, gear, mods, and throwables now pop up an unlock notification, just like tools do.
 End Run Recap Improvements: Skipping the animation won’t throw you into a loading screen anymore, so you can actually see your results.
 Base Camp UI Upgrade: Worktables now show an icon if you have enough materials to build them. Also, expansions now preview their next upgrade benefits.
 Caravan Requirement Added: The Caravan is now needed for other worktables. Plan accordingly!
 Status Stack Recap Added! Along with stats, you’ll now see a summary of your current status effects and what they do. Hover over them for details!
 Crafting QoL Improvements: Removing items from the craft list properly updates the materials list now and holding the craft button will proceed to craft the selected item. No more unnecessary clicking!
 Weapon Stat Bars Are (Mostly) Fixed! Accuracy has been improved, but we're still fine-tuning the numbers.
 Egg Offering UI Upgrade: Slots now show the egg’s name, so you don’t have to be a paleontologist to remember which one is which.
 Muddy Butch Fight Rework: Attack patterns have been adjusted to create better attack windows.
 Gamepad Navigation Improvements: UI navigation is smoother and more responsive now.
 Item Dropping Tweaks: Items can now be dropped by holding X (keyboard) or the west button (controller).
 Storage Box Improvements: It's now easier and more intuitive to equip attachments and to move stacks between your backpack and storage.


🔥 That’s All for Now!

Thank you for all your feedback, bug reports, and chaotic gameplay moments. You’re making Dino Path Trail better every day!

Now, go grab that update and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.17 is Live! Key Fixes and Improvements for Dino Path Trail Demo
notes.content:
Howdy, Gunslingers!

Your playtests, feedback, and bug reports have been absolute game-changers, and today, we’re rolling out our first patch based on everything you’ve shared with us!

Before diving into the details, a quick reminder:
💡 Using the in-game Bug Report tool is crucial! It sends us your save file, current session log, and even the previous session log, meaning if the game crashes or you restart, we can still access valuable info to track down the issue.
So, if your UI or game gets stuck, you can reload and send a report, to let us know what happened. We’ll check the logs and get to work!

🛠️ Major Fixes:

 Blessings & Modifiers: Many effects that weren’t applying correctly to Lucy are now working as intended. (Daredevil Blessing was indeed a scam 😅 our bad)
 Graphical Fixes: No more mysterious black bands on terrain and minimap for certain resolutions.
 Difficulty Adjustment: Max difficulty has been slightly lowered. Enjoy the (temporary) mercy!
 Improved Inventory Navigation: Mouse & Keyboard users will find it much easier to select and move items! This feature is still in testing tho, so it will probably be improved more with the following patches.
 Lichens Visual Update: We’ve given the Lichens a little makeover! They’re no longer hiding in plain sight, making it much simpler to gather the resources for those much-needed healing items.
 Rifle Rework: All rifles have been reworked, so now they actually feel like you’re shooting a classic Winchester, not a wet noodle.
 Gamepad Disconnection Handling: If your controller disconnects, the game will pause and smoothly switch to Mouse & Keyboard after your current action is complete. Now you have time to rage-throw your controller before grabbing your trusty M&K.

🐛 Minor Fixes & Tweaks:

 Quest Fixes: No more Grim Claws asking you to eliminate "0" bandits or dinosaurs.
It should also prevent the UI from disappearing, but let us know the result.
 UI Anchoring: Like any wanted poster, floating UI elements are now properly pinned down.
 Loading Screen Glitches: Possible fix for screens getting stuck when transitioning between menus.
This seems to happen rarely, but we've added a couple of logs to investigate further in case it isn't resolved. If your screen turns darker than Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon after returning to the main menu, please send us a bug report using the in-game tool.
 Looting Fix: Some items were playing hard to get: gathering them didn’t give you anything! Well, no more! You’ll actually get the loot you deserve when you pick things up.
 Tutorial Fixes: The Saltpit no longer self-destructs after gathering. it's not a secret message for James Bond, after all.
 Hovering UI Issues: Fixed invisible elements blocking clicks.
There might be more sneaky ones lurking around! If your mouse starts acting weird, like not hovering or clicking properly because of some invisible force field, give us a shout!
 Missing Strings & Localization: More missing texts have been found and resolved. Keep an eye out for any that remain!
 Weapon SFX Tweaks: More Pew Pew Pew, less muffled gunfire.
 Video Settings Adjustments: Better real-time adaptation when changing resolution/display.
Let us know if you see something strange happening (or not happening, lol).
 Widescreen Resolutions Removed: Sorry ultra-wide folks, balancing the game for that view would be too time-consuming, so black bars it is!

🚀 Features & Fixes moved to Backlog:

 UI Scaling System: We’re working on an optional UI scaling feature for better accessibility (especially for Steam Deck players).
We’d rather not turn our game into a free eyeglasses giveaway with every purchase!
 Aim Assist Improvements: We know it’s not always perfect, and we are discussing possible improvements about the aim assist system with controller for future updates after the core game is complete.


Thank you all for your amazing support, this is just the beginning! Keep the bug reports and feedback coming, and we’ll keep making Dino Path Trail even better!

👉 Now go update, play, and let us know what you think! 🔥
